title: Learning to Report Unsafe Tasks in a Multi-Agent Game
abstract: arXiv:2610.09002v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When a team of agents shares a reward for completed tasks, reporting and stopping unsafe work reduces the team's reward. Random audits that penalize silence can make universal reporting optimal without ensuring that a silent team learns to report. We study this problem in a game where any witness can stop a task by reporting. When a task's k witnesses share a policy and draw actions independently, the derivative of expected reward with respect to the shared silence probability at universal silence counts its benefit k times, while the comparison between universal reporting and silence counts it once. A fully shared policy can therefore be locally attracted to silence even when reporting is optimal. For any grouping into shared policies, we give an audit condition sufficient for exact policy-gradient updates to reach universal reporting and, outside boundary cases, necessary from near universal silence. translated_title: 多智能体博弈中学习上报不安全任务
translated_abstract: 当一组智能体共享完成任务所得的奖励时，上报并停止不安全的工作会减少团队的总奖励。惩罚沉默的随机审计可以使“普遍上报”成为最优策略，却无法保证一个保持沉默的团队能够学会上报。我们在一个任何目击者都可以通过上报来停止任务的博弈中研究这一问题。当一项任务的 k 个目击者共享同一策略并独立抽取动作时，在普遍沉默点处，期望奖励对共享沉默概率的导数会将沉默的收益重复计算 k 次，而“普遍上报与沉默”之间的比较只将其计算一次。因此，即使上报是最优的，完全共享的策略也可能在局部被吸引到沉默状态。对于任何按共享策略的分组，我们给出了一个审计条件：它对精确的策略梯度更新达到普遍上报是充分的，并且在非边界情形下，从接近普遍沉默的状态出发也是必要的。在一个平衡家族中，满足……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了多智能体共享策略下“沉默陷阱”的成因——共享策略的梯度会把沉默的收益重复计入 k 次，使团队局部收敛于沉默——并给出了一个审计惩罚条件，使策略梯度更新能够可靠地收敛到普遍上报不安全任务（在多数情形下既充分又必要）。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies why fully shared policies in multi-agent games can be locally attracted to silence (the policy gradient over-counts silence's benefit k times) and derives an audit condition that is sufficient—and, outside boundary cases, necessary—for policy-gradient updates to reach universal reporting of unsafe tasks.
